description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: What National Weather Service alerts are active for this state, zone or point? Active National Weather Service alert records for one state/area code, one UGC zone, or one lat,lon point, passed through unedited with source and fetched_at (cached up to 60 s). Not a warning service and may be delayed or incomplete: use official NWS channels for safety decisions. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NOAA/NWS. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

area.description: two-letter state/area code, e.g. TX (give exactly one of area, zone, point)

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: nws_alerts
title: NWS active alerts (unedited) (paid: 0.003 RLUSD / 0.003 USDC on Base / 0.003 RLUSD on Base via x402)
